1.question: If the people's sins were like scarlet, what did God say they would become?

2.question: What did God say people would do with their swords one day?
answers: Beat them into plowshares to farm with

3.question: What did the proud daughters of Zion do that displeased the LORD?
answers: They walked proudly, showing off their beauty
They sang songs in the temple
They gave their food to the poor

4.question: What did the Branch of the LORD do for his people?
answers: He washed them and made them clean

5.question: In God's song about the vineyard, what did the owner do when the grapes were bad?
answers: He took down its hedge and let it be trampled and wasted

6.question: What did the angel touch Isaiah's mouth with?

7.question: What was the sign God gave King Ahaz?
answers: A virgin would have a baby boy

8.question: What long name did God tell Isaiah to give his son as a sign?

9.question: What did Isaiah say about the baby who would be born to rule?
answers: He would be called 'Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace'
He would be the strongest man alive

10.question: God said the mighty Assyria was like tools in His hand. Which tools?

11.question: From whose family would the promised king come?
answers: David's — a shoot from Jesse's stump

12.question: In Isaiah's song of thanks, what would God's people draw with joy?
answers: Water from the wells of salvation

13.question: What did Isaiah say would happen to Babylon?
answers: It would become the biggest city
It would be the friendliest place
It would fall forever and never rise again

14.question: Who was called 'the morning star' who fell from heaven?

15.question: Whose cry of sadness did Isaiah write about?

16.question: How long did God say Moab would be like a servant counting the years?

17.question: What would happen to Israel and Syria (Ephraim and Damascus)?
answers: They would both be judged and scattered, but a remnant would return
They would build a big temple

18.question: What would the tall people of Cush (Ethiopia) one day bring to the LORD's mountain?

19.question: What surprising blessing did God speak over Egypt in this chapter?

20.question: For how many years did Isaiah walk barefoot and stripped as a sign against Egypt and Cush?

21.question: What did Isaiah say about Babylon?
answers: She would rule the whole world
She would become friends with Israel
She would move to the desert
Babylon would fall, and her idols would be broken

22.question: God said He would put the key of whose house on Eliakim's shoulder?

23.question: What did Isaiah say about the trading city of Tyre?
answers: They would teach God's people to sail
Tyre would be laid waste, and her great ships would mourn

24.question: What did Isaiah say would happen to the whole earth?
answers: It would stay the same forever
It would turn into a giant garden
It would become one big city
It would be laid waste and emptied

25.question: What did Isaiah say God would swallow up forever?

26.question: What did Isaiah say about trusting God?
answers: God keeps in perfect peace those who trust in him
God only helps people who are rich

27.question: What big sea creature did Isaiah mention that God would punish?

28.question: What did Isaiah say the leaders of Ephraim were like?

29.question: The people honored God with their lips — but what was far from Him?

30.question: What did Isaiah say about Egypt's help?
answers: It came with lots of gold
It was worthless — Egypt's help would come to nothing

31.question: What did God tell the people of Judah to do instead of asking Egypt for help?
answers: Look to the Holy One of Israel who made them

32.question: What did Isaiah sing about a king who would rule in righteousness?
answers: He would be mean to everyone
He would be like a hiding place from the wind and a shelter from the storm
He would live in a big palace

33.question: What did Isaiah say would happen to Assyria, who had plundered others?
answers: It would be plundered and destroyed itself

34.question: Which land did Isaiah say would become a burning, empty desert where wild animals live?

35.question: What did Isaiah say would happen to the desert?
answers: It would become glad like a garden with flowers and streams of water
It would turn into a city

36.question: Who stood outside Jerusalem's wall and shouted threats to scare God's people?
answers: The Rabshakeh, the Assyrian king's commander

37.question: How many Assyrian soldiers did God's angel strike down in one night?

38.question: What did Hezekiah do after he got better?
answers: He wrote a song thanking God

39.question: What did God tell Isaiah would happen to God's people someday?
answers: They would be carried away to Babylon as captives
They would become the biggest army
They would never be sad again

40.question: What did God say about the grass and flowers?
answers: They wither and fall — but God's word stands forever
They sing songs to the sun

41.question: What did God tell His people not to be afraid of?
answers: Their enemies, because 'I am with you'

42.question: What did God say about His servant?
answers: He would fight all the battles
He would be gentle — a bruised reed he would not break

43.question: What new thing did God say He was doing?
answers: He would make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert

44.question: What did God say about idols made of wood and stone?
answers: They were nothing — only the LORD is the true God

45.question: What did God say about King Cyrus before he was even born?
answers: He would be a shepherd who would set God's people free
He would be the richest man
He would be a famous painter
He would live to be 200 years old

46.question: What did God say about the idols that people carried around?
answers: They were heavy and had to be carried — they could not save anyone

47.question: What did Isaiah say about Babylon the queen?
answers: She would be kind to everyone
She would live forever as a queen
She would sit in the dust, weak and afraid, and never be queen again

48.question: What did God say He had done for His people even though they were stubborn?
answers: He had announced things before they happened and kept them safe
He had given them lots of toys
He had made them the tallest people
He had taught them to fly

49.question: What did God say His servant would be to the nations?
answers: A light to bring God's salvation to the whole world

50.question: What did God say He gave His servant's back to?

51.question: What did God tell His people to do when they felt weak?
answers: Look to Abraham, their father — and God would comfort Zion

52.question: What did the watchmen on the walls of Jerusalem shout?

53.question: What did Isaiah say about the servant who suffered for others?
answers: He was pierced for our sins — like a lamb led to be killed
He ran away from his enemies
He was the richest man in town

54.question: What did God tell the 'barren' woman to do?
answers: Sing and shout for joy — her children would be more than the married woman's

55.question: Who did God invite to come and drink freely?

56.question: What did God say about foreigners who loved Him?
answers: They could not be part of God's people
They were welcome — His house would be a house of prayer for everyone

57.question: Who did God say He comforts?
answers: The humble and contrite in spirit

58.question: What kind of fasting did God really want?
answers: Not eating food for a day
Sharing bread with the hungry and helping the poor

59.question: What did Isaiah say the people's sins had done between them and God?
answers: They separated the people from God, so He would not hear

60.question: What did Isaiah tell God's people to do when God's light came?
answers: Arise and shine — their light had come

61.question: Who did God say His Spirit was upon?
answers: The one anointed to bring good news to the poor

62.question: What did God promise never to keep silent about?
answers: Zion — He would not rest until her salvation shone like the sun

63.question: What color were God's garments when He came back from fighting for His people?
answers: Red — like one who had stomped on grapes in the winepress

64.question: What did Isaiah pray God would do like a potter with clay?
answers: Remember them and not be angry forever — like clay in the potter's hands

65.question: What did God say He was ready to do for people who did not even ask?
answers: Be found by people who were not even looking for Him

66.question: What did Isaiah say God would make at the end?
answers: A brand new heaven and a brand new earth where everyone would be happy
